text:
maria: Quick kickoff — Q2 console observability roadmap. Need to align tradeoffs for dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdowns, and error analytics. Customer asks piling up; want a proposal by EOD Friday.
kevin: +1. Can we capture the asks into 2 buckets: (A) surface + alerts (broad, low-cost) and (B) deep analytics (narrow, higher cost)?
nina: technical constraint: tracing hooks can spike p99 latency if we attach heavy context for every request. Need sampling and async enrichment.
jamal: customer ask: per-route token cost + per-customer spend alerts. Also link a sample trace to the billing line item.
maria: exact. We should be able to answer: "why did cost increase for route X last week?" with trace + sample prompt + token breakdown.
kevin: proposal sketch: Phase 1 = dashboard templates + per-route cost metric + lightweight trace sampling (1-5%). Phase 2 = attribution pipeline, trace enrichment, queryable trace store, and error analytics workspace.
nina: implement sampling at the edge with a deterministic sampler + header to mark sampled requests. Enrichment can be done downstream to avoid blocking inference path.
jamal: for Phase 1, we can ship a quick SQL/Grafana dashboard:
```sql
-- per-route token cost last 7d
SELECT route, SUM(tokens * unit_price) as cost
FROM usage
WHERE ts > now()-interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY cost DESC
```
kevin: acceptance criteria (Phase 1):
- dashboard showing per-route cost (last 7/30/90d)
- ability to filter by customer/org
- trace sampling integrated with dashboard drilldown (click -> opens trace viewer for sampled requests)
- sampling overhead < 1% added p99 latency
- alerting rule for >20% week-over-week route cost jump
maria: product trade-offs to call out in doc: retention vs cost, sampling rate defaults, what counts as "trace linkable" to billing (token-level vs request-level), and UI surface for non-technical users.
nina: question: retention window for trace store in Phase 2? 30 days sounds reasonable for troubleshooting, but costs jump. Maybe 7 days default + paid tiers for 30/90.
jamal: +1 to tiering. Also we'll need a gated rollout for Dedicated/Private since some customers won't want trace data leaving their VPC.
kevin: ops note: telemetry pipeline needs an idempotent enrichment job that maps trace_id -> billing_event_id. We'll add a small queue between collector and long-term store.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new branch "obs/phase1-cost-dash" pushed, CI passed, staging deploy queued. :rocket:
maria: can we scope a minimal UX for Phase 1? My ask: single landing dashboard, route list, cost sparkline, and a "drill into samples" modal that shows 3 example traces per route.
kevin: timeline: 2-week sprint for core metrics + dashboard + trace sampling plumbing. Phase 2 planning starts once we have real metrics from Phase 1.
nina: blockers: tracing SDK changes (minor), collector config (sampling support), and storage schema for trace->billing mapping. I'll add tasks.
jamal: I'll draft the customer acceptance test cases: recreate-cost-spike, link-trace-to-invoice, and alert-fires-on-surge.
maria: ok lets each own: kevin -> dashboards & alerts, nina -> tracing infra, jamal -> acceptance tests & customer comms. I'll own prioritization and go/no-go decision.
kevin: thanks. I'll upload the rough mockups and sample queries to the shared doc by EOD.
maria: perfect. If anyone has pressing objections to the two-phase split, speak now. Otherwise we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
